messages:
dina: Quick check-in: we need a concrete onboarding + feedback playbook for the pilot ambassador cohort. aim: 10 orgs, 6-week engagement, low ops overhead.

omar: Can we split partners into 2 tracks? 'sandbox' (hosted API) and 'onprem trial' (Private). Different checklists.

dina: yes. tracks make sense. sandbox track = fast onboarding, less infra support. onprem = legal + infra signoff.

kelly: Suggested gating: basic score from intake form >= 7 -> invite. otherwise short call to qualify. Intake should ask: technical lead github, primary use case, data sensitivity, traffic estimate, preferred deployment.

yoav: For feedback loops: weekly 20m demo + async evidence uploads (small reproducible cases). Use a shared Google Sheet + Linear board for triage. Also require running our smoke harness: `ci/eval_smoke.py --n=200` within first 10 days.

sophie: Incentives tiering proposal: Tier A (deep integrations) = $5k credit + 2 oncalls; Tier B (surface-level) = $1k credit + advisory invite. All get swags. NDA required for Tier A.

dina: timeline: open applications Monday, close 10 days later, invite batch 1 same day, onboard next Monday. We need invite email + quickstart guide.

omar: Onboarding docs: minimal checklist for Private: open ports, KMS ARN, service account, minimum GPU spec. For Hosted: token provisioning, CORS, sample curl.

kelly: Metrics to lock: integration time (days), mean latency delta, # of blocking bugs, partner satisfaction (weekly survey 1-5). Success = 8/10 partners onboarded within 14 days + avg satisfaction >=4.0.

yoav: Rollback policy: if partner sees >1 critical regression tied to model update, we freeze updates for them and open a hotfix channel. Document exact steps in runbook.

sophie: Recruiting notes: prefer partners with a public repo or demo app we can use as reference. also ask whether they can share anonymized logs for perf analysis.

dina: I'll draft invite copy and two quickstart guides (Hosted + Private). kelly, can you own intake form + scoring? yoav -> eval harness & runbook. omar -> infra checklist. sophie -> incentives + legal loop.

onboarding-bot: New doc created: https://docs.internal.redwood/pilot-playbook (created by @dina)

kelly: confirmed. will add gating rules: green (auto), amber (follow-up call), red (decline). scoring fields: use-case fit, ops burden, security fit, likelihood to be reference.

yoav: confirmed. I'll write the smoke harness and add a small `./ci/check_install.sh` for partners to run.

omar: confirmed. I'll include minimal VPN matrix and sample KMS policy.

sophie: confirmed. I'll coordinate with legal on credit terms and NDA template.

dina: Great. Final ask: try to have invite + shortstart up live by Thu so recruiting can start. I'll circle back Friday with draft email.
